title: Ring Buffer vs Queue (v3 pipeline test)
_doc: V3 visual-first: no narration. Beats are plain time ranges; 'micro' lists the on-screen micro-text for that beat (documentation only). The optional groove block adds a frame-quantized background pulse; R.onBeat() in simulation.js fires on exactly the same frames. Uses its own pulse groove, so the default music bed is turned off ("music": false).

beats.cue: Linear queue dequeues and shifts 6 items left while the ring just hops one pointer
Zoom into slots 6,7,0,1: producer writes on the beat, consumer reads on the off-beat, HEAD wraps 7->0
Producer bursts 4x faster, consumer stalls, buffer fills, pressure tone + filter opens
Balanced flow, HUD SHIFT_COST 0 / O(1) STEP, payoff stamp
